name: What is trenchless sewer pipe repair, and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is trenchless sewer pipe repair, and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trenchless sewer pipe repair is a method that minimizes digging to fix or replace damaged sewer lines. There are two main types: pipe bursting and pipe lining. Pipe bursting involves pulling a new pipe through the old one, simultaneously breaking apart the old pipe. Pipe lining, or Cured-In-Place Pipe (CIPP), involves inserting a resin-coated liner into the existing pipe, which is then inflated and cured to form a new, seamless pipe within the old one. This method saves landscaping and reduces disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trenchless repair methods, like pipe bursting or pipe lining, fix sewer pipes with minimal digging by creating a new pipe inside the old one.
